FIR Filed Against Rahul Gandhi, Pappu Yadav Over Ram Temple Protest

On [date], FIRs were filed against Rahul Gandhi and Pappu Yadav in Varanasi for their alleged role in a provocative performance at the Ram temple. The police received a complaint alleging that the protest was an affront to religious sentiments. The FIRs were filed after a complaint was lodged with the police, claiming that the protesters had violated the law by wearing saffron clothing and performing a provocative act. The police have started investigating the matter based on the complaint. Three MPs, including Rahul Gandhi, Pappu Yadav, and Avdesh Prasad, were named in the FIRs.
